reviewer.display_name: AI-assisted translation and adversarial preflight (not a human reviewer)

findings.explanation: The unquoted draft phrase tiếng không rõ ràng could mean an unclear sound. Quoting “không” throughout the refusal/vows restores the explicit and emphatic refusal.
The draft nóng nảy softened violento. Revised to tính khí hung bạo while avoiding the unsupported assertion of proven physical abuse.
Roca antigua is rendered generally as antique precious stones; the exact historical jewelry sense and singular/collective force remain uncertain.
The idiom un decir Jesús is rendered with both a time gloss and the religious utterance. A bilingual editor should decide whether this doubles the explanation and slows the conversational voice.
The long ceremony paragraph preserves the source’s accumulating clauses, but Vietnamese breath groups and social-register terms still require read-aloud literary revision.

No llegó á tanto describes an aborted insult; chưa adds a not-yet implication which the source does not establish. The recorded draft rendering was revised after an additional AI-assisted adversarial reading.
In this sequence dureza is harshness, not neutral or admirable firmness. The recorded draft rendering was revised after an additional AI-assisted adversarial reading.
Medio ambiente includes the social setting and constraints, not only the onlookers. The recorded draft rendering was revised after an additional AI-assisted adversarial reading.

summary: AI-assisted direct Spanish-to-Vietnamese draft and adversarial preflight only, covering all 15 historical paragraphs. The narration remains explicitly imagined until the later conversation; no modern diagnosis is added. Preflight fixed the dangerous unquoted không ambiguity and strengthened violento beyond mere irritability. The exact jewelry sense of roca antigua, the idiom un decir Jesús and the long social tableau remain open editorial questions. The provisional weighted score is 8.425 (reported 8.43), below the publication threshold; this is no human approval and supplies neither reviewer evidence nor an open-license grant. An additional AI-assisted read corrected 3 documented local fidelity issues without changing the advisory score.
